authoringMethod: Offline candidate segmentation uses inherited unambiguous pure-kanji readings, pykakasi for unmatched Japanese runs, and explicit context/compound/numeric/acronym overrides. Pykakasi is build-time scratch only, no runtime dependency. Non-Japanese punctuation is preserved before conversion to avoid pykakasi equals-sign corruption.

corrections: Preserve full-width equals in equations (pykakasi dropped/duplicated it)
Avoid matching kana-inflected inherited fragments inside compounds such as 掲示する
秤量器=ひょうりょうき / 計量器=けいりょうき / 測定機器=そくていきき
人時=にんじ / 仕掛品=しかかりひん / 総出来高=そうできだか / 実稼働中=じつかどうちゅう
Table 表=ひょう; person 人=ひと outside numeric counter; clock 9時=くじ,14時=じゅうよじ; 100分=ひゃっぷん
Compound suffix readings for 者/書/物/時/済み and 部分/全員分
製造時/清掃時/販売時 and other source-specific time suffixes
規格外=きかくがい / 外れ値=はずれち / 検査値=けんさち / 合格値=ごうかくち
位置付け=いちづけ / 複数人=ふくすうにん / 増え方=ふえかた / 仲間=なかま
Acronyms and quantity/time/person-hour counters explicitly read

limitations: No new source competence/content/answer certification; this unit adds readings only.
Single AI lexical and contextual review is not native pronunciation certification; residual contextual/compound reading risks remain until independent review.
The 2000 fields were all mechanically checked and context-scanned; full independent sentence-by-sentence review has not been completed.
Formula punctuation/operators are retained plain; numeric/Latin token coverage is not a claim of complete spoken-formula narration.
kg/時 uses the candidate reading きろぐらむまいじ; native contextual acceptance remains pending.
No browser/native/device claim in this worker; root owns integration and QA.
